notes.title: VR Launch Update!
notes.notes: [p]Hey Commanders,[/p][p][/p][p]We hope you've been enjoying update 4 of Grit & Valor - 1949! [/p][p][/p][p]We have some news regarding the Steam VR version of our game. We are working hard on updates to address feedback we have recently received. With our focus on improving the experience of Grit & Valor - 1949 for all platforms. The Steam VR version will no longer be launching this week as planned. We apologise for this inconvenience and want to ensure you have the best possible experience when playing.[/p][p][/p][p]Please continue to share any feedback and we promise to keep you updated on any upcoming patches and the launch of the VR version.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you again for your patience and continued support. [/p]

notes.title: Update 4 OUT NOW and VR Launch Update!
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings, Commanders![/p][p][/p][p]The fourth post-launch update which comes with a huge list of improvements, balancing and fixes is out now. These include a special focus on post-game content: "[b]Threat Levels[/b]" and a re-work of the [b]Overclock[/b] system.[/p][p][/p][p]We have an update regarding the VR version coming to Steam. Due to an unexpected technical issue with the game, the launch of the VR version has been delayed to next week. We apologise for this inconvenience and want to ensure that you have the best possible experience when playing. We promise to keep you updated on the situation and to let you know once the VR version is officially out next week.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for understanding and for always supporting our game, in the mean time, we hope you enjoy the changes in update 4. We'd love to hear what you think, so let us know by joining our [url="https://discord.gg/xd3dnxUDR5"]Discord server[/url] and sharing your feedback.[/p][p][/p][h2]Threat Level Rising[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039714/889b4d26d98cfacd32a00ef871647a05b4606a96.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Threat Levels[/b] have been activated across all regions, marking the beginning of [b]a new post-game campaign[/b]. Each region now comes with [b]five escalating Threat Levels[/b]. The further you push, the tougher enemies become.[/p][p]
Every Threat Level comes with a set of [b]Directives[/b], high-risk challenges that must be completed in a single mission. Succeeding earns you [b]Medals, Command’s new currency[/b] for unlocking higher Threat Levels.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039714/987381d2077754e3885f131d30e02a68aaa6af07.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Combat balance has been overhauled to match the rising challenge, so expect tougher fights, tighter margins, and deadlier choices. The [b]War Room’s[/b] been retooled to support this new structure. You’ll find Threat Levels front and centre in mission prep, making it easier to track your progress and plan your next deployment.  [/p][p][/p][p]To read more about Threat Levels, check out [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1911860/view/499455821076234421"]our preview post from last week[/url].[/p][p][/p][h2]Overclocks Reforged[/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039714/d216011ea36869f4876aee63893a74b9e9c897f7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We also recently posted a preview of the Overclocks re-work! [url="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1911860/view/499455821076234423"]You can find it here in case you missed it[/url].[/p][p][/p][p][b]Overclocks[/b] are no longer tucked away in the Mech Yard, but now [b]earned in the thick of battle[/b]. You’ll unlock and equip them mid-run, shaping your firepower and tactics in [b]real time[/b]. If you spent Intelligence or Blueprints unlocking Advancements or Overclocks before, Command’s issuing full refunds.[/p][p]
Overclocks are now organised into [b]10 specialist categories[/b], each one pushing your mechs in a new tactical direction. Not every mech can access every category, so you’ll need to know your unit and [b]make your choices count[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039714/77d295cf6e2695ed4da41bb133d7d5015f3b5687.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Power (the way Overclocks are unlocked) has also changed. It’s now [b]fuelled directly by Boosts and Enhancements[/b]: each one you slot in adds to your [b]Overclock ‘Power’ capacity[/b]. We’ve lowered the thresholds to get you into the action faster, and you’ll see your Power Level front and centre when selecting upgrades. [/p][p][/p][p]We also added a [b]new Overclock reward screen[/b] and upgraded the Squad Overview so you can track your build at a glance.[/p][p]
Command is also dropping [b]43 brand-new Overclocks[/b] into the rotation. Some existing ones have been reworked, others reassigned as Enhancements, and one decommissioned entirely. [/p][p][/p][h1]Changelist[/h1][h2]Threat Levels[/h2][list][*][p]Added Threat Levels which scale the difficulty of the region.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Directives which reward Medals to unlock Threat Levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Added 'View Directives' button to Region Map to track progress.[/p][/*][*][p]End of Run Module rewards quality is now determined by Threat Level instead of Region.[/p][/*][*][p]End of Run rewards now show what Directives were completed on that run.[/p][/*][*][p]Run History now shows what Threat Level it was played on.[/p][list][*][p]Runs from before this update will display as 'Threat Level 1'[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039714/cb47efa0a919e997a1efa4fcec809e2c7e4f5414.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Overclocks[/h2][list][*][p]Overclocks have been changed from a meta reward to a run reward.[/p][list][*][p]The Mechanical Surge Advancement and any Overclocks unlocked before this update will have the Intelligence and Blueprints refunded.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Overclocks are now categorised into 10 specialisations with only certain mechs having access to each Overclock specialisation.[/p][/*][*][p]Power for Overclocks is now granted by Boosts and Enhancements, each one equipped giving 1 Power.[/p][/*][*][p]Power required for Overclocks reduced from 4, 12, 20 to 4, 8, 12.[/p][/*][*][p]Mech Power Level is now shown when selecting a Boost or Enhancement.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new reward screen for when you are choosing an Overclock.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Overclocks visuals on the Squad Overview.[/p][/*][*][p]Overclocks are now displayed in the Run History.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted pre-existing Overclocks:[/p][list][*][p]Apex Hunter renamed to Apex Sniper.[/p][/*][*][p]Deadeye renamed to Sniper.[/p][/*][*][p]Flawless Fury renamed Flawless Sentinel and now increases Repair instead of Damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Last Siphon renamed to Redline and Health Threshold reduced from <50% to <40%.[/p][/*][*][p]Phoenix Protocol renamed to Redline Protocol and can now trigger once every combat instead of once every mission but only restores 10% health, down from 50%.[/p][/*][*][p]First Strike has been renamed to Lethal Overwatch.[/p][/*][*][p]Ward of Steel has been renamed to Aegis Ward.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed Vigor Rage to a Forge Industries Enhancement.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed Shell Striker to a Warhead Enhancement.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Gold-Tipped Rounds.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][/*][*][p]Added 43 new Overclocks:[/p][list][*][p][b]Aegis[/b] - While this mech is stationary, it gains Barrier every 5 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Reactive Aegis[/b] - When this mech is attacked, a nearby ally gains a stack of Barrier.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Aegis Echo[/b] - When this mech gains Barrier, a nearby ally also gains a stack of Barrier.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Aegis Conduit[/b] - When this mech loses a stack of Barrier, a nearby ally has some health restored.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bastion[/b] - At the start of each wave, this mech gains armour.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bastion Cascade[/b] - When this mech gains armour, a nearby ally gains a percentage of the armour also.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bastion Reserves[/b] - When this mech restores health in combat, it gains a percentage of the health as armour.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enduring Bastion[/b] - At the end of each wave, if this mech took damage, its repair is increased for the rest of the mission.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Spiked Bastion[/b] - While Armoured, when this mech is attacked, it reflects damage back at the attacker.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Deadlock[/b] - Each time this mech attacks it gains fire rate, stacking up to 10 times. This bonus is lost when this mech stops attacking.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Deadlock Breach[/b] - Every 5th attack this mech makes against a Weak enemy deals massively increased damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Deadlock Calibration[/b] - Every 5th attack this mech makes against an enemy mech increases its damage for the rest of the mission.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Deadlock Echo[/b] - Every 5th attack this mech makes against the same target will cause a Double Tap.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Deadlock Harvest[/b] - Every 5th attack this mech makes against an Armoured enemy, it gains armour.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Executioner[/b] - This mech's attacks deal increased damage to enemies at low health.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Executioner's Edge[/b] - Every 5th enemy this mech kills increases its critical chance for the rest of the mission.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Executioner's Feast[/b] - When this mech kills an enemy with a critical hit, it restores health.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Executioner's Streak[/b] - Every enemy this mech kills increases its damage and critical hit damage. These bonuses are lost upon taking damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Executioner's Wrath[/b] - Every 5th enemy this mech kills increases its damage for the rest of the mission.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Overwatch[/b] - When this mech has been stationary for 5 seconds its attack range is increased.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enduring Overwatch[/b] - When this mech remains stationary for an entire wave, its maximum health is increased for the rest of the mission.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Deadly Overwatch[/b] - Each time this mech kills an enemy its damage is increased. This bonus is lost when this mech moves.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Critical Overwatch[/b] - While this mech is stationary, it gains critical hit chance every 5 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Phalanx[/b] - When this mech has allies nearby, they all gain increased damage resistance.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Phalanx Barrage[/b] - When this mech has allies nearby, they all gain increased fire rate.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Phalanx Guardian[/b] - When this mech is destroyed, a nearby ally gains increased health and repair for the rest of the mission.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Phalanx Reprisal[/b] - When this mech is attacked, a nearby allies next attack deals increased damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Phalanx Resolve[/b] - When this mech kills an enemy, a nearby ally restores health.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Adrenal Redline[/b] - While at low health, this mech's fire rate and movement speed are increased every second, stacking up to 100 times.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tempering Redline[/b] - While at low health, this mech has increased damage resistance.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Vengeful Redline[/b] - While at low health, each time this mech takes damage, its damage is increased for the rest of the mission.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sentinel[/b] - At the end of each wave, if this mech is at high health, its gains armour.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enduring Sentinel[/b] - At the end of each combat, if this Mech is at high health, its health is increased for the rest of the mission.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Iron Sentinel[/b] - Every 10 seconds this mech doesn't take damage, it gains armour.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Resilient Sentinel[/b] - While this mech is at high health, its damage resistance is increased.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Disciplined Sniper[/b] - Every third attack this mech makes against Distant enemies deals increased damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Elevated Sniper[/b] - While this mech is on High Ground, it has increased critical hit chance and critical hit damage.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Relentless Sniper[/b] - When this mech critically hits a Distant enemy, its critical chance is increased for the rest of the mission.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stalker[/b] - While this mech is Alone, its critical chance and critical damage is increased.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stalker's Ambush[/b] - Every 5 seconds this mech spends Alone, it gains increased fire rate, stacking up to 10 times. This bonus is lost when this mech moves.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stalker's Reach[/b] - While this mech is Alone, its attack range is increased.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stalker's Resurgence[/b] - When this mech kills an enemy while Alone, it restores health.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stalker's Stabilizer[/b] - At the end of each wave, if this mech is Alone, its repair is increased for the rest of the mission.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039714/b944d96fd5797536b841670f2d4f4dfc49600654.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]General Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Cover can now be taken advantage of from either side.[/p][list][*][p]We have also disabled Cover tile indicators as they felt unnecessary now that Cover is 2-sided.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Cover throughout every level in every region has been rearranged to work better with the new 2-sided system.[/p][/*][*][p]Extract Objectives now move independently but there speed has been reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]Extract Objectives now show the path they will take.[/p][/*][*][p]Wave Start/End effects now trigger during Boss Fights.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhancement Upgrades now only appear as rewards once you have at least 3 Enhancements.[/p][/*][*][p]Repair Kit wont start appearing until a unit is below 80% health, down from 90%.[/p][/*][*][p]End of Run Module rewards are now given after your first ever run.[/p][/*][*][p]Command Centre Research Tasks can now be progressed on the first run.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Gameplay Balance[/h2][list][*][p]All Regions difficulty has been re-balanced. The difficulty curve is now a lot smoother between Regions/Threat Levels than previously where each Region had a big difficulty jump.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Hidden Node count in New Germany from 6 to 8[/p][/*][*][p]Western Europe Boss now fires its Mortar Cannon less frequently.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy waves in the Western Europe Boss now spawn less frequently and ramp up in difficulty slower.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy waves in the Scandinavia Boss now spawn less frequently.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy waves in the British Isles Boss now spawn more frequently and start off harder.[/p][/*][*][p]All Scandinavian Levels have had adjustments to make them easier to navigate.[/p][/*][*][p]Many levels across all Regions have been adjusted to improve gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Movement Speed of Enemy Heavy Tanks.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Movement Speed of all Player Units[/p][list][*][p]Command Vehicle Movement Speed increased from 10 to 15.[/p][/*][*][p]Thunderhead Movement Speed increased from 10 to 15.[/p][/*][*][p]Draqan Movement Speed increased from 20 to 25.[/p][/*][*][p]Ironclad Movement Speed increased from 15 to 20.[/p][/*][*][p]Vulcano Movement Speed increased from 10 to 15.[/p][/*][*][p]Steelhawk Movement Speed increased from 20 to 25.[/p][/*][*][p]Leadslug Movement Speed increased from 15 to 20.[/p][/*][*][p]Warbringer Movement Speed increased from 15 to 20.[/p][/*][*][p]Clusterstorm Movement Speed increased from 20 to 25.[/p][/*][*][p]Meltdown Movement Speed increased from 20 to 25.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Increased effectiveness of Field Repair Ability Upgrades.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased effectiveness of Field Sentry Ability Upgrades.[/p][/*][*][p]Field Sentry upgrades now increases its health instead of its critical chance.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Field Sentry's attack range from 2 to 3.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Field Sentry's critical chance from 10% to 25%.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased damage gained from Forge Armour's damage upgrade.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased ability charges gained from Mine Drops ability charge upgrade.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased ability charges gained from Airstrikes ability charge upgrade.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased ability charges gained from Jump Jets ability charge upgrade.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased ability charges gained from Airstrike ability charge upgrade.[/p][/*][*][p]Mechano-Arm now starts with 4 ability charges, down from 6.[/p][/*][*][p]Forge Armour now starts with 4 ability charges, down from 5.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased cooldown of Mechano-Arm from 20 to 25 but also increased cooldown reduction gained from its cooldown upgrade.[/p][/*][*][p]Ability Charges no longer appear as a mid-level reward.[/p][/*][*][p]Ability Recharger item at the Scavenger now restores 2 ability charges and now has a much higher possibility of restoring 3.[/p][/*][*][p]Enduring Regens health gain has been reduced from 10/20/35/50/75 to 5/10/15/20/30.[/p][/*][*][p]Savage Fortitudes health gain has been reduced from 20/30/40/50/75 to 10/20/30/40/50.[/p][/*][*][p]Vengeful Resurge healing has been reduced from 50/75/100/150/200 to 30/60/90/120/150.[/p][/*][*][p]Weakpoint Recharge ability charge chance reduced from 5/10/15/20/25% to 2/4/6/8/10%.[/p][/*][*][p]Volatile Defense has had its internal cooldown on the Disable proc increased and on the Armour proc decreased.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Settings[/h2][list][*][p]Removed the "Graphics Quality" setting which previously affected shadows, lighting, texture resolution and anti-aliasing.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Shadow Quality setting which defaults to High.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a Texture Quality setting which defaults to High.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an Anti-Aliasing setting which defaults to 4x (previously 8x, which is still an option).[/p][/*][*][p]Added an Ambient Occlusion setting which defaults to On.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Optimisations[/h2][list][*][p]Optimised level geometry to reduce overlapping and unnecessary polygons.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked attack VFX for the Warbringer to improve performance, especially when multiple Warbringers are active at once.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a throttling system to prevent too many VFX piling up on a single tile at once.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked level backgrounds to reduce complexity and rendering cost.[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked tile indicator logic to improve CPU performance and reduce rendering cost, especially when a unit is selected.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed Mechano-Arm Critical Plating Augment increasing Armour instead of Health.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Combat Text sometimes appearing as though its a critical hit even though it isn't a critical.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Repair Kit reward choices displaying mech image twice instead of the reward icon.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed health bar colours being inconsistent on the gameplay hud and squad overview.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed unit frame backgrounds on squad overview not displaying correctly when a unit has lots of upgrades equipped.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Bomber Plane notification appearing in the British Isles region.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Vulcano mech not animating correctly when moving at high speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Leadslug mech not using correct walk animation.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Leadslug's bullets extending far beyond its attack range.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Steelhawk not using correct footprint decals.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Warbringer attack SFX drowning out other SFX and preventing pilot voicelines from playing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed End of Run Module rewards sometimes being lower rarity than they should be.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Deliver Objectives using incorrect icons.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Command Vehicle Ability Upgrades not being applied correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Deliver Objective markers on the New Germany Boss disappearing after the cutscene finishes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several Objectives not displaying outlines.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed selection issues with the gamepad after purchasing an item from the Scavenger.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed selection issues with the gamepad on the Region Map.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed being able to select duplicate mechs and pilots during the squad setup.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Explosive Sentry Augment not increasing Field Sentries range.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Western Europe Boss Phase not progressing when the Pylon was destroyed too quickly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed being able to assign Pilot Abilities to the Command Vehicle during the squad setup.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Accessibility colours not affecting Unit Markers if changed during gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Enemy Units continuing to shoot at Extract Vehicle after the Objective is completed.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]...and that wraps up the changes from Update 4! As mentioned at the top of this post, your support and feedback mean everything to us. We'd love to hear from you, so consider joining the [url="https://discord.gg/xd3dnxUDR5"]Megabit Discord[/url] server to talk us directly about the new update and any queries you have regarding the VR news.[/p][p]See you on the battlefield![/p][p][/p][p][i]The Grit and Valor - 1949[/i][/p]

notes.title: Post-Launch Update 3: Style Your Squad
notes.notes: [p]Greetings, Commanders![/p][p][/p][p]Our third post-launch update has just arrived and is packed with overall quality of life improvements, balance changes and bug fixes. [/p][p][/p][p]As special thanks for your continued support, the update will also contain brand new skins for your mechs! We'll share these throughout the post below. You can apply these to your in-game squad back at Resistance HQ.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039714/7863a54661d53d49083661e59d10a5d4b791dc36.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]General Improvements[/h2][list][*][p]Added clearer UI cues for incoming Mortar Planes, Bomber Planes, and Airships.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced visual feedback when your units take damage, including improved overhead markers and updated unit frames.[/p][/*][*][p]Boss health bars now display segmented indicators to mark phase transitions.[/p][/*][*][p]Ability Augments now display any stat changes they apply directly on the Augment rewards.[/p][/*][*][p]Added loading screen hints for regrouping, setting target priorities, and using the mark target feature.[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced Mech Skins so you can now customise your entire squad before heading into battle.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039714/b45972efc74d7e571e1c4757060599eb6579a45d.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Balancing Changes[/h2][p][/p][h3]Difficulty[/h3][list][*][p]Increased difficulty rating of the Thunderhead, Steelhawk and there elite variants so these enemy Mechs shouldn't spawn as early in runs.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced damage of Mortars from the Mortar Planes in the British Isles from 75 to 50.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced spawn rate of Mortar Planes in British Isles from every 15 seconds to 20 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Elite nodes in the British Isles region now don't start appearing until later in the region.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced damage of the Bomber Plane in Scandinavia from 100 to 60.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced spawn rate of the Bomber Plane in the Scandinavia Boss fight from every 12 seconds to 20 seconds.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Gameplay [/h3][list][*][p]Increased duration of Ruptured Status Effect from 4 to 5 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased duration of Burn Status Effect from 4 to 5 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased duration of Blind Status Effect from 4 to 5 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased duration of Defective Status Effect from 4 to 5 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased duration of Exposed Status Effect from 4 to 5 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased duration of Tagged Status Effect from 2 to 1.5 seconds.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Field Repairs[/h3][list][*][p]Field Repairs duration has been reduced from 8 to 7.5 seconds.[/p][list][*][p]The number of times it heals stays the same but now heals slightly faster.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Field Repairs Rapid Calibrations fire rate increase duration has been increase from 6 to 10 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Field Repairs Dead Drop damage has been increased from 100 to 200.[/p][/*][*][p]Field Repairs Disruptor now also increases duration of Field Repairs by .5 seconds each time the Unit using it is attacked (up to 2.5s).[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Airstrike[/h3][list][*][p]Airstrikes Long Fuse damage bonus has been increased from 50% to 75%.[/p][/*][*][p]Airstrikes Danger Close has been reworked.[/p][list][*][p]Airstrikes damage is increased by 75% if targeted within 2 tiles of the Pilots Mech.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where bonus damage was being applied even when augment wasn't equipped.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Airstrikes Double Explosion now only deals 50% damage on the second strike.[/p][/*][*][p]Airstrikes Incendiary Bombs fire damage has been increased from 5 to 15.[/p][/*][*][p]Airstrikes Stun Bombs now requires a critical hit to Disable the enemy and now also increases the abilities critical chance by 15%.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]Remote Mine[/h3][list][*][p]Remote Mines fire damage has been increased from 5 to 10.[/p][/*][*][p]Remote Mines Far Away has been simplified and no longer ramps up over time, instead its damage is now increased by 75% after moving at least 4 tiles.[/p][/*][*][p]Remote Mines Fuel for the Fire now also increases the damage of the fire by 50%.[/p][/*][*][p]Remote Mines Fire Trail now also increases the Hunter Seekers movement speed by 50%.[/p][/*][*][p]Remote Mines Shocking Impact now reduces the Hunter Seekers movement speed by 25%.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039714/06b5ebe2eafa49a989289545b86a09ac5fe20130.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Jump Jet[/h3][list][*][p]Jump Jets Armor Smasher damage against armored units has been increased from 50% to 75%.[/p][/*][*][p]Jump Jets Bombing Run bombs now deal 50 damage instead of 10% of Jump Jets damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Jump Jets Shock and Awe now also reduces the Jump Jets damage by 20%.[/p][/*][*][p]Jump Jets Meteor damage increase per tile has been reduced from 10% to 7.5%.[/p][/*][*][p]Jump Jets Return now grants the Mech 50% fire rate for 10 seconds when it notes.title: Post-Launch Update 2: Chain of Command
notes.notes:
Greetings, Commanders!

With this update, our goal is to put tactical command firmly in your hands. We're introducing new tools to coordinate your squad with greater precision, whether it’s by locking onto high-value targets, setting unit-specific priorities, or issuing instant regroup orders in the heat of battle. 

Every change is designed to deepen your strategic options and reward smart decision-making on the field.

[h2]Tactical Improvements[/h2]

[h3]New Command: Regroup[/h3]

When things get messy, you need to pull back fast and smart. That’s where Regroup comes in. One command, and every unit in your squad will rally to a point you choose. No fumbling, no delay. You can issue it with a quick click of the Regroup button at the bottom right of your HUD, or by using your assigned keyboard or gamepad binding. Use it wisely, it might just save your squad.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039714/edaafae6c0157e2ee85ca371c01149c4760cc8d4.gif[/img]
[h3]New System: Target Priorities[/h3]

Outnumbered? Surrounded? Doesn’t matter, what matters is who you hit first. With the new Target Priorities system, each of your mechs follow orders the way you see fit. You set the rules, they execute. Choose from the following priorities:
[list]
[*] Type
[*] Weak
[*] Healthy
[*] Injured
[*] Far
[*] Close
[/list] Access this feature through the Squad Overview by clicking the button on your HUD, or use your assigned keyboard or gamepad binding. Once you’re in, you’ll see toggles on each unit to set their priorities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039714/7ee3095b1750b04fadb114c3d5217e4bb7bf994f.gif[/img]
[h3]New Option: Focus Fire[/h3]

Sometimes it’s not about who's the biggest threat, it’s about finishing the job. With Focus Fire, your units will stay locked on their target until it’s scrap, no matter what else steps into range. You can toggle this setting for each unit in the Squad Overview.

[h3]New Command: Mark Target[/h3]
With this new command, you can manually designate a priority target on the battlefield using your mouse or gamepad cursor. Once marked, that enemy will be focused down by your squad, ignoring all other orders.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039714/b40d4ce53c7c4051c901fcb4edb993cb71306aad.gif[/img]
[b][h2]Thank You, Commander [/h2][/b]
Before we get into the rest of the update changes below, we wanted to say a thank you for your continued support. To celebrate the latest update, we’re giving all players a new Command Vehicle skin which you'll be automatically granted upon downloading the update. This is our way of showing appreciation for being part of the Resistance. Equip your new looks, hit the battlefield, and show your enemies what style under pressure really looks like!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039714/e89f68af46928aed8d3ce653c366e54b2b0da254.png[/img]
[h2]General Improvements[/h2][list]
[*] Mechs and Pilots already assigned to your squad can now be selected in Squad Select to more easily compare stats.
[*] Squad Select layout has been refined for improved clarity and ease of use.
[*] You can now compare current vs. new modules more clearly when viewing modules in the Mech Yard.
[*] Fusing Modules in the Mech Yard now provides additional information about potential resulting modules.
[*] Ability attribute values are now shown in the Pilot Barracks.
[*] The Squad Overview open/close animation has been sped up for a smoother experience.
[*] Attributes in Squad Overview are now navigable, with tooltips displayed when an attribute is selected.
[*] Overclocks are now visible within the Squad Overview.
[*] Boosts in Squad Overview now display the exact stat increase they provide.
[*] Removed General Larkin’s voiceover warnings for Critical Hits and High Ground damage.
[*] Added a new voiceover from General Larkin when the Command Vehicle takes damage.
[*] Increased the size of damage numbers during gameplay for better visibility.
[*] Boss phases are now indicated on the boss’s health bar during fights.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed bosses not highlighting correctly in High Contrast Mode.
[*] Fixed boss level objectives not highlighting correctly in High Contrast Mode.
[*] Fixed destroy objectives not highlighting correctly in High Contrast Mode.
[*] Fixed 'Pilot Mute' option not working.
[*] Fixed text line spacing on 'Skip Hints & Tips' description.
[*] Fixes and optimizations to entity outlines.
[*] Fixed tooltip titles extending outside tooltip box.
[*] Fixed pilot upgrade tooltip overlapping elements in 16:10.
[*] Fixed module slot notification remaining after salvaging/fusing all available modules for that slot.
[*] Fixed mech's upgraded visuals not displaying correctly in the Mech Yard after equipping an overclock.
[*] Fixed fusing tutorial not progressing correctly when using keyboard or gamepad bindings.
[*] Fixed repair kit reward not healing for the displayed amount.
[*] Fixed 'Squad Overview' key bind being called 'Enhancements' in settings menu.
[*] Fixed the extract tile indicators still showing after the extract vehicle has been destroyed.
[*] Fixed the extract vehicle still occupying its tile after being extracted.
[*] Fixed Command Vehicle not displaying the correct skin on the HUD.
[*] Fixed an issue where tooltips did not update after upgrading an ability in the Pilot Barracks.
[*] Fixed tooltips on Run History covering up most of the information.
[*] Fixed tooltips on Squad Overview making gamepad navigation difficult.
[*] Fixed boost tooltips not having names.
[*] Fixed boost tooltips width being incorrect.
[*] Fixed access denied tooltip not appearing on Command Centre when it is locked.
[*] Fixed enhancements for dead mechs appearing as a choice when awarded.
[*] Fixed Jump Jet not displaying correct stat values for kills and damage dealt.
[*] Fixed reroll text on rewards screen not displaying correctly when it is affordable.
[/list]As always, we appreciate your feedback and support. Share your thoughts and experiences with the update in our [url=https://discord.gg/8eqDpa88nf]Official Discord server[/url].

[i]The Grit and Valor - 1949 Team[/i]

notes.title: Update 1: First Steps & Wargames Fest
notes.notes:
Greetings, Commanders!

[h2]Wargames Fest - Demo Back Online![/h2]
Before we dive into the update notes - we're delighted to be a part of the ongoing Wargames Fest on Steam. To celebrate, we have put our free demo back  online. so it's the perfect time to try Grit and Valor for free and share it with your friends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039714/803eb5a5c43ddcbb3b5e66a83fa2744d166b7f1d.png[/img]

[h2]Update Notes[/h2]
The first of three post-launch updates has arrived! As promised, we focused this month's changes on improving the experience for new players and getting them into the action quickly. The update also brings a series of quality of life improvements and bugfixes.

Here's what's changed:

[h3]Early Game Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]You now begin with a full squad from the start of the game with Thunderhead unlocked.[/b]
[*] Valor Currency can now start being earned after the first run instead of only after the Pilot Barracks is unlocked.
[*] After finishing the tutorial you now go back to the Resistance Base.
[*] The tutorial no longer awards black coins on completion.
[*] Reduced power needed to activate Overclock slots from 10, 15, 20 to 4, 12, 20.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039714/d34e3f3c8f5845eb6eb6e03f2872f7b9e73438fb.png[/img]
[h3]Command Center Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Command Center Advancement tab is now displayed as a tech tree, showing future unlocks.[/b]
[*] Command Center upgrades have been re-arranged and costs adjusted.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039714/3d5ba78bb88b6e7982074b81857c3621601bbe35.png[/img]
[h3]Control Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted the size and position of units' selection colliders to make them easier to select.
[*] The camera now adjusts its pivot to match the height of the tile in the center of the screen, making it easier to select high ground tiles near the edges of the map when using a gamepad.
[*] When using a gamepad, the camera moves to the middle of the nearest tile when you stop panning.
[*] The path and range indicators no longer appear when hovering over a tile you cannot move to.
[*] The path and range indicators now update correctly when selecting units with the 1-4 hotkeys on keyboard or cycling through them with the bumpers on a gamepad.
[*] An outline now appears on the tile you are currently hovering over if a unit can move to it.
[/list]
[h3]UI Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] On the Region Map, you can now navigate to future level nodes to view their tooltips when using a gamepad.
[*] While navigating the Region Map with a gamepad, the map now auto-scrolls to frame the currently selected level node if it is offscreen.
[*] Moved the Main Menu panel and Pause Menu panel closer to the middle of the screen when using an ultrawide resolution.
[*] Added a smooth scrolling effect to some menus.
[*] Slightly increased the height of the Settings Menu to show an additional item in the scrollable list.
[/list]
[h3]Game Balance[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased Health and Armor of all enemies in Western Europe by 10% and increased damage by 8%.
[*] Increased Health and Armor of all enemies in New Germany by 15% and increased damage by 13%.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed units walking on top of each other when passing by on ramps.
[*] Fixed Savage Momentum Enhancement at Rare rarity increasing damage by 75% instead of 7.5%.
[*] Fixed Weakness Damage Boosts not appearing as a Boost Reward Choice.
[*] Fixed the Scandinavia boss mech not appearing during its intro cutscene.
[*] Fixed the currently selected level not being framed correctly when returning to the Region Map and using a screen resolution other than 1080p.
[*] Fixed Disruptor and Revenge Field Repairs Augments not triggering correctly.
[*] Fixed focus loss that could occur when failing a level or retreating which prevented reward cards from being claimed when using a gamepad.
[/list]
Thanks as always for your continued support! We'd love to hear your thoughts on the above changes, especially once you have tried them in-game. Let us know what you think here on Steam or in the official [url=https://discord.gg/8eqDpa88nf]Grit and Valor[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/xd3dnxUDR5]Megabit Discord[/url] channels.

[i]The Grit and Valor - 1949 Team[/i]

notes.title: Post-Launch Update Roadmap
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45039714/8955ad9b32c6fd9e45f4b8b54d0e60ad5be2f631.png[/img]

Greetings, Commanders!

We trust you're finding success on the battlefield and throughout your campaigns. To better equip you for the battles ahead against Axis forces, we've prepared the following intel:

[h3]Three Key Updates Incoming[/h3]
First off, thank you all so much for your feedback and reviews. We've taken your recommendations to heart and used them to shape three major updates. These will roll out at the end of each month over the next three months, bringing both quality-of-life improvements and new gameplay features.

[h3]April Update: Early Game Overhaul[/h3]
This month, we're refining the early sections of the game. One major change is that all three mechs and pilots will now be available right from the very first mission. Originally, we staggered their introduction to create a smooth progression from the tutorial (with just one mech) to a full squad. However, many players felt this limited early-game momentum, so we're opening things up.

We're also upgrading the Command Centre. Instead of a simple menu, you'll now see a full upgrade tree that clearly shows all unlock paths. This should make it much easier to plan your progression and strategize your upgrades.

[h3]May & June: Gameplay Updates[/h3]
Looking ahead, the May and June updates will introduce fundamental gameplay changes. Each will add new mission types where progressing requires alternate objective to surviving enemy waves. More details to come, but we believe this will add much greater variety to your campaigns. Additional feature changes are coming in the form of Mech Overclocking...more on that later.

Expect a full breakdown at the end of this month when the first update drops—so stay tuned!

For ongoing updates and discussion, be sure to join both the [url=https://discord.gg/8eqDpa88nf]Grit and Valor[/url] and [url=https://discord.gg/xd3dnxUDR5]Megabit[/url] Discord servers.

Best,
[i]The Grit and Valor – 1949 Team[/i]

notes.title: Patch Notes: Display Settings and Other Fixes
notes.notes:
Greeting, Commanders!

Following your bug reports and feedback we have implemented the following changes:

[h3]Display Settings Fixes[/h3]
We have overhauled the system for managing display settings to address cases that were not fixed by the previous patch. The changes include:
[list]
[*] When you change the resolution, display or window mode and select Apply in the Settings menu, the game now saves your changes without re-applying them.
[*] When you make changes in the Settings menu and select Revert, the game applies your previously saved display settings and refreshes the settings text once the changes have finished applying.
[*] When you select Defaults from the Settings menu, the game returns to your main display (the first one in the Display list) and uses that display's native resolution in Borderless window mode. If the native resolution is reported as portrait, the game translates it to landscape.
[/list]
[h3]Known Issues and Limitations[/h3]
[list]
[*] The UI is designed for a minimum aspect ratio of 16:10 (commonly used on laptops and handhelds), so we don't recommend using any narrower resolutions. The 4:3 and 5:4 resolutions are automatically filtered out.
[*] Portrait displays such as vertical monitors are not supported, so the game may behave unexpectedly if you try to move the game window to them.
[*] When setting the Window Mode to Fullscreen and using a resolution other than the display's native resolution, the game may not display correctly. If you need to use a non-native resolution, we recommend using Borderless window mode.
[*] You may see unusual resolutions in the list which are larger than your display's native resolution (e.g. some 1440p monitors may also list 4K as an option). This is normal as the game reads from the same list of resolutions available in Windows Display Settings, even if they cannot be applied.
[/list]
[b]Please Note[/b]
If the game launches in an incorrect resolution or does not let you select a playable resolution after installing this patch, please follow these troubleshooting guidelines:

[b]Reset Settings to Defaults[/b]
The game may be trying to load an invalid resolution that was saved in a previous patch, so please try reverting your settings to defaults. If you cannot do this in-game, follow these steps:
[olist]
[*] Close the game.
[*] Delete your Settings.ini file which can be found in this folder: %USERNAME%/AppData/LocalLow/MilkyTea/Grit and Valor
[*] Launch the game again.
[/olist]
[b]Report a Bug[/b]
If you have tried the above and the game still does not display correctly, please follow these steps to send us more information so we can debug the issue:
[olist]
[*] In your Steam Library, right-click the game and select Properties, then go to the Betas tab and enter the password fixthescreens. 
[*] Opt into the mt_debug_display branch which should appear.
[*] Download and install the beta update.
[*] Launch the game.
[*] Open the Display Debugger menu from the top of the screen. This menu is centered horizontally so it should be accessible even if the game launches in a narrow resolution.
[*] Take a screenshot of the game while the Display Debugger menu is open (press F12 to capture via Steam).
[*] Upload your screenshot and send it to us either in this Steam discussion or in the bug-reports channel on the Grit and Valor Discord.
[/olist]
[h3]Other Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Bomber Plane not appearing in the Advanced Combat levels in New Germany.
[*] Fixed dead units causing navigation issues and units to spin on the spot.
[*] Fixed tile issues in Western Europe levels in which inaccessible tiles were selectable, causing mech pathing issues.
[/list]
Thanks for your patience while we have dealt with these bug reports. We appreciate all the feedback and will continue investigating any future reports. You can share your experiences here on Steam or via the official [url=https://discord.gg/8eqDpa88nf]Discord[/url].

[i]The Grit and Valor - 1949 Team[/i]

notes.title: Update: Control Scheme Improvements
notes.notes:
Greetings, Commanders!

Thank you as ever for your determined efforts to liberate the British Isles! Your feedback and reviews throughout the demo have been incredibly helpful. Based on your suggestions, we’re making changes to the controls. These are now live in the demo and will also feature in the final release on 26 March.

[b]NOTE: Existing players will need to reset controls to default for some of these changes to take effect.[/b]

[h2]General Improvements[/h2]
[h3]Unit Cycling[/h3]
Previously, Cycling Units would default to the same mech, making moving your whole squad tedious with this method. It looked something like:
[olist]
[*] Press Cycle Units which would select the first unit (e.g. Ironclad).
[*] Move Ironclad to a tile, at which point the Ironclad gets deselected.
[*] Press Cycle Units, which selects the Ironclad again.
[*] Press Cycle Units again for it to then Select the next unit (e.g. Draqan).
[/olist]
Now, the system will automatically move along to the next unit in order by default to help you cycle through them more quickly.

[h2]Keyboard + Mouse Changes[/h2]
[h3]Left Click/Right Click[/h3]
Units are now selected with the left mouse button and moves with the right mouse button by default. This is more in line with other RTT and RTS games. The units’ colliders have also increased in size, making them easier to select quickly. We hope this makes manoeuvring your squad more fluid!
Gamepad and touch controls remain in the one-button style for convenience on those control schemes.

[h2]Gamepad Changes[/h2]
[h3]Unit Cycling[/h3]
Cycling through units is now bound to the left/right bumpers by default (previously left/right on the d-pad). This allows you to cycle through units at the same time as controlling the camera more easily.

[h3]Freeze Time[/h3]
Moving the unit cycling to bumpers has displaced the default for the freeze-time binding. This is now moved to X (Button West), the last remaining free face button.

Thanks once again for all your suggestions! We firmly believe these changes will greatly improve the experience of quickly manoeuvring your squad. Let us know what you think, here on Steam and in our official Discord.

[b]REMINDER: Existing players will need to reset controls to default for some of these changes to take effect.[/b]

[i]The Grit and Valor – 1949 Team[/i]
